programmes.d: Can our budget build rival a new Lexus? For our first project, we're taking a bone stock 2011 Lexus IS 250 and spending as little as possible to make it look and drive like a 2025.

Is custom exhaust worth it on a budget build? The age-old question -- does tone matter when dollars do? Will our custom exhaust take our Lexus IS250 up a notch or will we have to cut back to finish our build?

Balling on a budget means spending your money wisely; Brian and Jason order a complete body kit for their 2011 Lexus IS 250 from China, and they're cracking open the crate! Will it work or do they have to cut it to fit?

It's the final weekend push that Brian and Jason have to upgrade their 2011 Lexus IS 250, Project Budget Baller; they've only got 48 hours to install a new head unit, better speakers and gloss black wheels and tires; will they finish on time?
